hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles all swap accounting itself: depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 pool math. beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate revert to prevent unused concentrated liquidity positions and accidental donations.
